description: This source file defines the DeletePolicyStrategy class, which handles the deletion of policies within the system. It extends an abstract class to implement specific command handling logic for DeletePolicy commands, producing corresponding events and responses.

classes.name: DeletePolicyStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that processes DeletePolicy commands by generating a PolicyDeleted event and a response, updating entity tags, and logging the action.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Implements the core logic to handle a DeletePolicy command, producing a Result containing a PolicyDeleted event and a response.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag of the previous policy if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional as deletion implies no further entity tag.
